tags.keyRequiredLabels: Key, English label, and Hebrew label are required.

sla.intro: Per-priority SLA target in minutes. A job is past SLA when (now - assigned at) exceeds the smaller of its priority target and the severity ceiling.
sla.invalidRange: Target minutes must be a positive integer up to 7200 (5 days).
sla.severityNote: Severity ceilings are fixed in code: critical 240m, major 1440m, moderate 4320m, minor 10080m. Effective SLA = min(priority, severity).

cron.intro: Manual triggers for scheduled jobs. Each job is normally invoked on a schedule with the CRON_SECRET bearer token; the buttons here run the same code immediately and write an audit row.

sla-breach.label: SLA breach scan
sla-breach.description: Scan active jobs whose elapsed-since-assigned time has exceeded their SLA target and write one sla_breached notification per assignee. Respects notifications_enabled and sla_breach_automation_enabled.

recurring-jobs.label: Recurring job writer
recurring-jobs.description: Scan active recurring job templates whose next run time has passed and create a Job per template. No-op when recurring_jobs_enabled is off.

client-health.label: Client health snapshots
client-health.description: Compute weekly per-client KPI snapshots and upsert one row per client per ISO week. Idempotent. No-op when client_health_snapshots_enabled is off.

sectionHints.identity: Legal name and contact details. These appear in receipt headers.

validation.urlInvalid: Website must start with http:// or https://.

validation.vatBpOutOfRange: VAT basis points must be an integer between 0 and 10000.
validation.countryInvalid: Country must be a 2-letter ISO code.

recurring.intro: Templates that spawn a new Job on a schedule. Each template runs in its own transaction and writes an audit row. Use Pause to stop generation without losing history.
recurring.flagOff: Recurring jobs are disabled. Enable the recurring_jobs_enabled feature flag to turn this on.
recurring.deleteConfirm: Deleting a template stops future generations but keeps previously generated jobs. This cannot be undone.
